alt: Apple HomeView smart displays in four colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — showing their rounded square screens mounted on white domed speaker bases
story: Apple launched the $299 HomeView smart display on October 13, 2026 with a 7-inch square screen (like an oversized Apple Watch) that shows widescreen 16:9 video in only 56% of the panel with black bars on all sides — and Apple's own Apple TV+ streaming service isn't available on it at launch.
why_funny: Apple built a product called a smart 'display' whose main use-case (video) fills less than 60% of the screen, then forgot to put their own streaming service on it.
